records.answer_summary: Both reports identify two operating segments, Graphics and Compute & Networking, and describe an All Other category of unallocated enterprise expenses. claims.statement: The FY2022 report identifies two segments: Graphics and Compute & Networking.
The FY2023 report identifies two segments: Compute & Networking and Graphics.

The earlier Graphics description covers GeForce/GeForceNOW, workstation/vGPU and automotive infotainment/Omniverse; Compute & Networking covers Data Center, Mellanox networking, automotive AI, CMP, Jetson and enterprise software.

The later Graphics description retains those broad areas with updated RTX/Omniverse wording; Compute & Networking includes Data Center, networking, automotive AI and electric-vehicle platforms, Jetson, enterprise software and CMP. This is a description comparison, not an equivalence or causal-reclassification finding.
Both reports identify All Other as enterprise costs not assigned by the CODM to the two segments; the lists of disclosed costs differ.
Both reports say some prior fiscal-year balances were reclassified to conform to current presentation, without identifying a segment-specific recast in those statements.

limitations: Shared segment names do not prove all underlying boundaries are invariant. Generic reclassification boilerplate does not establish which segment amounts were recast or why.
